gen-gf-libertinus-mono-montserrat: Flattened pen-nib bowls give Libertinus Mono its look. It does precise, gently modulated headings well, while Montserrat glides along in generous, wide-mouthed sans curves.
gen-gf-libertinus-mono-work-sans: Work Sans is signage-plain, every line weight alike, with c tips that keep their distance. Libertinus Mono earns its keep big and short, where robust downstrokes and slender turns can show.
gen-gf-lisu-bosa-gf-cascadia-code: Literary up top, wiry below. Lisu Bosa does the mild thick-thin shading of a serif with authority, while Cascadia Code runs a smooth monoline sans-serif path around every bend.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-amulya: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders low and its terminals pointing outward. Its high lowercase against the moderate height of Amulya, a sans with generous curve gaps, is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-fs-bespoke-: Terminals that end exactly as wide as they began mark Love Ya Like A Sister, a display face with a level, unaccented beat. Against Bespoke Slab's low, grounded serif, that blunt uniformity is the draw.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-cossette: Cossette Titre tucks its open bowls close together, with capitals barely taller than the lowercase. And if Love Ya Like A Sister were shrunk down, its single-weight rounds and stems would lose their punch.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-noto-san: Chunky, loose, and a bit cheeky, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders low and its curves untapered beside Noto Sans Newa. That sans-serif's open lowercase e is the sharpest difference.
gen-gf-maiden-orange-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Big lowercase, tight spacing, ribbon-cut ends: that's Maiden Orange in a glance. And Be Vietnam Pro, bent-steel sans-serif strokes with a high mean line, can take a generous body size without crowding.
gen-gf-major-mono-display-fs-erode: Erode reads dignified and editorial, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders. Major Mono Display brings a drafting-pen line of zero contrast, so the text serif's soft swell stands out against it.
gen-gf-major-mono-display-fs-ranade: Precise is the word for Major Mono Display, whose unmodulated line crosses every glyph. Ranade does the opposite job, letting weight drift gently along each rounded sans stroke with widely spaced, spread-out ease.
